title: time the math functions as Exudyn's C++ calls them, beside the library and the portable ones
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG4.1.3.5 (maintainer 2026-10-10: measure the performance of the native and the musl variant directly within the experimental function): implementation 'exudyn' of exudyn.experimental.EvaluateMathFunction evaluates EXUmath::Sin, ..., i.e. the library or, with EXUDYN_PORTABLE_MATH, the portable functions; mathFunctionsPlatform.py --timing shows std, portable and exudyn
releaseNotes: exudyn.experimental.EvaluateMathFunction(..., implementation='exudyn') evaluates and times what the C++ code of Exudyn calls (EXUmath::Sin, ...); mathFunctionsPlatform.py --timing shows the library, the portable functions and this side by side
